dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: We promised each other that we'd buy a shop in Hanamizaka when we made enough money so that more people would be able to try our snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: ...But during the autumn two years ago, he didn't listen to me and insisted in purchasing goods in pouring rain. In the end...

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Now, the best way for me to remember him is to run this stall well and cherish our memories together.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: If you would visit more often, dear customer, that would certainly help him rest in peace...
